translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Corintogi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Corintios

content: Cristo gannar durgusad-igar
Gwenadgan, emigindi an bemarga sogbar, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedgi an bemarga sunmakapidgi, bemar A-gaya-burba-nued abingasmalad, emigi amba agi bemar nanadimalad.
Deginbali, ar an bemarga sunmakapidgi, ar bemar amba a-gaya-burba-nuedgi nue nanadiile, bemar agi abonolesmardo, ar unnila askinbi bemar bengussurmalar.
Igi an odurdaklesmoga, ayob an bemar-odurdaksamarmogad: Cristo anmar-iskued-ular burgwisad, igi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naidyob, deyob gunonikid.
Cristo napa-urba diglesad, degine, ibapaagi gannar durgusad, igi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naidyob, deyob gunonikid.
Cristo gannar durgusgu, Cefasse na magarosad. A-Cefasde Pedroye-nugbalid. A-sorba Cristo e-ambe-gakabogwadse na magarosbalid.
A-sorba gwenadgan-e-dula-ataled-ilatar-gwena-bukwadse magarosbalid, a-gwenadgan amba bukidar dula gudidiid, abar bato burgwismarbalid.
A-sorba Santiagose Jesús na magarosad, a-sorbali e-nuggi-barmilesmaladse na magarosbalid.
Geb a-sorba, napidgi, Cristo anse magarosmogad, an dule-wargwen igar-suli yo-e-ibagan-moe gwalulesayob an gunonikid.

Ar ani an Bab-Jesús-nuggi-barmilesmalad-e-solabalid an itodo. Deginbali, an Jesús-nuggi-barmilealidye nugsalege-wilubsulinad, ar ade Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-Bab-Dummadse-golega-danar-ambikunoni-damalad baregindii an gusad-duled.

Ar Bab Dummad nabir angi binsae-wilubsulinad, ar emigindi nabir angi binsanonikid. A-ular weyob an gudisunnad. Binsa Bab Dummad nabir angi binsassulid, ar ade emarba an bur-bule arbasad. Ar ani an arbassulid, Bab Dummad nabir angi binsasadba an deyob arbasad.
Degisoggu, an-dibe, igi, Jesús-nuggi-barmilearmalad-baigan-dibe, anmar bemarga weyob Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedgi sunmaksamalad, degine, bemar weyob A-gaya-burba-nued abingasmalad.
Dule-burgwisar gannar durgued-igar
Ar Cristogi sunmaklediir, Cristo burgwisgu, gannar durgusye, ¿ar degite ibiga bemar-abargi gwen-gwen sogsunna, dule burgwisar, geg gannar bar durguye?
Ar dule burgwisar, geg gannar bar durguele, Cristo burgwisgu, gannar bar durgussurmodo.
Ar Cristo gannar durgussulile, binsa Bab-igargi anmar sunmakdido, degine, bemar binsa Cristogi bensuli-gudimardo.
Degisoggu, anmar gakanba binsa Bab-Dummad-barsogdimarsundo, ar ade anmar sogdiid, “Bab Dummad Cristo-burgwisad gannar odulosye.” Bab Dummad Cristo-odulossurdo, ar burgwismalad gannar durgusulir.
Ar burgwismalad geg gannar durguele, Cristo gannar durgussurmodo.
Ar Cristo gannar durgussulile, binsa bemar Jesúsgi bensuli-gudimardo, ar degisoggu, amba bemar be-iskuedgi gudimarsundo.
Ar degisoggu, Cristoba-nai-burgwismalad abonolessurmarmosundo.
Ar Cristo unnila we-napnegginedginbi anmarga ibmar-nuedga guele, anmar bela dulemar-we-napnegginmaladba nue wiledimardo.
Emigindi Cristo dule-burgwismalad-abargi gannar durgusad. Cristo gannar durgusadgi, dule-burgwismalad-iduedga gunonisunnad.
Ar dule-wargwengi burgwed-igar nonisoggu, dule-wargwengi gannar-durgued-igar nonibardo.
Ar igi bela dulemarga Adángi burgwed-igar noniki, debayobi bela dulemar Cristogi durgunonimaloed.
Dule-burgwismalad Bab-Dummad-igar-mesisadba gannar durgunonimaloed: Cristo-inse durgusad, geb a-sorba Cristoba-nanaimalad gannar durgunonikoed, Cristo na eba-nanaimalad sudanikir.

Degi geb neg-bergued nonikoed, bela burbar-dummagan-neg-semamaid, bela burbar-sailaganga-gumaid, degine, bela burbar-gandikidba-gangued-nikmalad osulosar, geb degi Cristo na e-ganguedba neg-dakmaid, e-Bab, Bab-Dummadga-gumaidga na uknonikoed.
Ar Cristo neg-semai guer-gebed, bela e-istarmalad-birgi nakwedse.
Cristo solaba e-istarad-napi-osulogoedi, burgwed.
Sal. 8:6 Degisoggu, mag itoledo, Bab Dummaddi Cristo-urbaligwaa gunonisulid, ar ade Bab Dummad bela Cristo-urba ibmar urbisad.

Ar bela ibmar Cristo-urba urbilesale, geb Cristo na e-sunnad, na Bab-Dummad-Machi, Bab-Dummad-urbaligwaa na nanadoed, ar ade Bab Dummad bela Cristoga ibmar uksad. Geb agi bela Bab-Dummad-sogedba ibmar gunonisunnoed.

Ar deginbali, ¿degite ibiga burgwemalad-anar Bab-Jesús-digi-ogleged-igar imakmarsunna, ar dule-burgwarmalad gannar durgusulir? ¿Ar ibiga degite burgwemalad-anar Bab-Jesús-digi-ogleged-igar imakmarsunna?
¿Ar degite ibiga anmar wachi-iliba boni-abargi gudimarsunna?
Gwenadgan, napira an bemarga soged, ar igi weligwar an itoge, bemar Dummad-Jesucristoba-naidba, ayob an napira an bemarga sogbalid, an bane-bane burgwednaga gudibalid.

Ar unnila dule-macheredyob Efesogi achu-sapurbarmaladba an gar-itodii-gusale, ¿ar ibi-nued an egi amissunna, ar burgwarmalad gannar durgusulir? Ar burgwarmalad gannar durgusulir, degiir dulemar-sogmaladyob an damarmosundo:

content.text: An mas gunmarsundo, degi, an gobmarsundo,

content: Mer be yardaklemar: “Dulemar-nuegan dulemar-iskanaba akaele, iskuddamalad.”
Nue be binsamar, mer be bar iskumar, iskuedgi be nomar. Bemar-obingesaegala an bemarga soged, ar bukidar amba Bab-Dummad-wichuli gudimalad.
Pablo, dulemar igi gannar durgumaloedgi sunmaksad
Ar gwenna-gwenna sunna egisdamaloed, degite: “¿Dule-burgwismalad igi gannar durguoe? ¿Igi e-san daklegosunna?”
Ibmar-wichurmaladyob be gudimalad: Ar ibmar-gwag niegala be digedi, ¿bina ibmar-gwag-e-uka burgwe dasursi?
Ibmar be digedi, sapi-sunnad be digsulid, e-gwag be diged, ibu-gwag be digo-dibe, oros-gwag-sunnaa-dakleged-dibe, oros-gwag-dibe.
Ar Bab Dummad ega e-san ukeddi na igi-dakle ega ukbiedba ega uked. Degine, ibmar-gwaggala na egad-egad e-san ega uked.
Ar sanmar belagwapa emarbi daklesulid. Dulemar-san akar dakleged, ibdula-sanmar akar daklemogad, ibmar-gukuarmalad-san akarmogad, degine, uamar-san akarmogad.
Amba deyobmodo, nibneggined san-nikmogad, degine, napneggined san-nikmogad. Nibneggined-e-san-e-dakleged, degi, napneggined-e-san, eba akar dakleged, degine, yeer-dakleged eba akarbalid.
Dad-ibeler-gaed, nii-gaed-ebo, akalad, degine, niskwamar-gaed amba akarmogad. Ar na niskwamar na akar-akar gamalad.
Amba deyobmodo, dule-gannar-durguedsik. Dule-burgwisar diglesar, e-san nungudoed, ar gannar-durgusad-sorbardi bar nunguosulid.
Degi, dule-san istar-daklegedgi digleged. Durgunonikogudi, yeer-dakle durgunonikoed. Dule-san nollogwadgi digleged. Durgunonikir, nollosulidgi durgunonikoed.
Degine, dule burgwisar, e-san-we-napneggined digleged. Durgudagogudi, bato san gwagsado, san-burbaledse. We-napneggined-san nikad, degine, burbaled-san nikmogad.
Ar weyob Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaid:
Gn. 2:7 Adán-sorbaliddina, a-sogleged, Cristo, adina dulega burba-oduloged uked.
Ar dule-burbaled-insarsulid, san-we-napneggined-insa nonikid, geb a-sorba burbaled nonikid.
Dule gebe-we-napneggined-aideged, unnila we-napnegginedid. Dule sorba-nonimogad, we Bab-Jesús, wedi nibnegginedid.
Adán-san-nikusmaladyob we-napnegginmalad san-nikmarmogad, ar Cristoba-nanaimaladdi Cristoyob san-nikumarmogoed, ar adi nibneggi danikid.
Ar igi anmar dule-we-napnegginedgii daklemala, deyob anmar dakledapmogoed, dule-nibneggi-danikid daklegedyob.
Gwenadgan, we an bemarga sogdo, ar san-we-napneggined, geg Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidse doged. Deginbali, ar ibmar-nunguoed nibneg-nunguosulidse geg dogbalid.
Burgwedgi anmar nakwemaloed
Ar degi-inigwele, igar-dukuar-maid an bemarga sogodo: Bela anmar burgoedbisurmalad, ar degi-inigwele, bela anmar-san gwagoedbiid.

Ar napi gala-goloedgi, anmar-san ukiar, anmar ibya-muru-sade-daedyob gwagoed. Ar ade gar goloed, geb agi dulemar-burgwismalad durgudagogu, bar e-san nunguosurmalad, degine, anmarmoga, anmar-san gwagmarmogoed.
Ar ade we anmar-san-nabir-nunguedi, gwager-gebed, geg san-nunguedse, degi, anmar-san-nabir-berguedi, gwager-gebed, geg san-berguedse.
We anmar-san-nabir-nunguedi geg nunguedse gwagsa sogele, anmar-san-sunna-berguedi geg berguedse gwagsa sogele, geb agi Bab-Dummad-Garda narmakar naidba gunonisunnoed:
Is. 25:8 Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaibalid:
Ar iskued, burgwed-e-boniganad, degine, Moisés-igar-mesisad iskuedga gangued uksad.
Anmar emigindi Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye sogmarsundo, ar anmarga anmar-Dummad-Jesucristoba burgwed-igargi nakwega anmar-imaknonigu.

Degisoggu gwenadgan, an na be-sabemalad, gatik gannaa be imakmar, degi, mer be akumalo, gatik Bab-Jesús-igargi arbanai be gumar. Ar bemar wisid, emi bemar Bab-Jesús-igargi arbananaid, binsa be alamaknanaisulid, bemarga igar-nuedga gumaloed.
